author: Moritz Schappler
name: combined-structural-and-dimensional-synthesis-for-parallel-robot-as-a-naval-testbed
notes:
This dataset contains the results of a combined structural and dimensional synthesis that has been performed for a case study of a parallel robot for use as a naval testbed as part of a paper published at MDPI Robotics in 2025.
The title is "Dimensional Synthesis of Parallel Robots Using Bilevel Optimization for Design Optimization and Resolution of Functional Redundancy", by Moritz Schappler (2025).  
The results in this dataset can be used to reproduce the figures and tables of the paper using the code from [the paper's GitHub repository](https://github.com/SchapplM/robotics-paper_mdpi2025_dimsynth). Further, they can be used as a starting value for performing other optimizations with the Matlab toolbox that is presented in the paper.
title: Combined Structural and Dimensional Synthesis for Parallel Robot as a Naval Testbed

resources.description: Each sub-folder contains one run of the optimization with results for each parallel robot in one .mat file and a csv table for summary. The settings of the run are stored in the respective settings file. The files are supposed to be opened with Matlab, as the whole toolbox is written in that language.
